message.content:
Looking at the code:

- Line 7: `htype` is the low byte of the 16-bit `type` field, so it ranges from 0 to 255.
- Line 9: If `htype < 0x80` (0-127), it calls `handle_optional_ext`.
- Line 12: For `htype >= 0x80` (128-255), it indexes `mandatory_handlers[htype]`.
- Line 2: `mandatory_handlers` has 255 elements (indices 0-254).

When `htype` is 255 (0xFF), `mandatory_handlers[255]` is an out-of-bounds access since the array only has indices 0-254.

The bug is on line 12, where the array access `mandatory_handlers[htype]` can go out of bounds when `htype` is 255.

Answer: 12
